name: Zeta Network Group
summary: Zeta Network Group functions as a company with a dual focus on entertainment and education. It delivers online entertainment performances and offers specialized music education programs. A key component of its business is "Color World," a comprehensive online platform. This platform provides a wide array of curricula, including topics such as music, sports, animation, painting and calligraphy, film and television, and essential life skills. Beyond its educational content, Color World also features lectures by celebrities, video recordings of celebrity concerts, exclusive merchandise, and opportunities for interactive communication with artists. Separately, the company also extends its services to include construction management consulting. Established in 2002 and based in New York, New York, the organization was formerly called Color Star Technology Co., Ltd., and is slated to adopt the name Zeta Network Group in August 2025.
